packageRules.description: Batch minor and patch bumps of the example apps' runtime dependencies (React, Vue, express, jQuery, …) into a single PR per update type. These back the demo apps rather than the Cypress techniques being demonstrated, so one PR beats 57.

Batch minor and patch bumps of non-Cypress build and lint tooling (webpack, babel, eslint, enzyme, …) into a single PR per update type. The negations hold Cypress and its plugins out of the group so they keep landing as individual, reviewable PRs.
